notes: Command data is based on the current 1.21.1 branch source.
Admin-restricted commands use operator/admin permission checks in current code.
The progression command tree is available both under /identity progression ... and /identity_progression ...

commands.name: /identity morph
commands.description: Morphs the executing player into a supported identity.
notes: Fails if swaps are disabled for that player.
By default non-operators must unlock the identity first.

commands.name: /identity clear
commands.description: Clears the executing player's current morph.
notes: Fails if swaps are disabled for that player.

commands.name: /identity list
commands.description: Lists unlocked identities for the executing player.
notes: This lists unlocked identities, not every morphable entity in the game.

commands.name: /identity unlock
commands.description: Grants one identity to the target player or to the command source player.
notes: Only morphable identities can be granted.

commands.name: /identity unlock all
commands.description: Grants all currently morphable identities to the target player or the command source player.

commands.name: /identity ability list
commands.description: Lists ability coverage for identities available to the current player context.
notes: Output distinguishes specific abilities, fallback abilities, and identities with no ability.

commands.name: /identity ability info
commands.description: Shows the resolved ability info for one identity.

commands.name: /identity ability current
commands.description: Shows the resolved ability info for the player's current morph.

commands.name: /identity config list
commands.description: Lists editable config keys exposed by the current command layer.

commands.name: /identity config get
commands.description: Shows the current value of one supported config key.

commands.name: /identity config set
commands.description: Sets one scalar config key and saves it.
notes: List-valued keys must use add/remove/clear instead.

commands.name: /identity config add
commands.description: Adds one value to a list-valued config key and saves it.

commands.name: /identity config remove
commands.description: Removes one value from a list-valued config key and saves it.

commands.name: /identity config clear
commands.description: Clears all values from a list-valued config key and saves it.

commands.name: /identity progression ui
commands.description: Opens the progression UI for a target player or the command source player.
notes: Also available under the standalone /identity_progression root.

commands.name: /identity progression charges get
commands.description: Reads the stored morph charge count for an identity.

commands.name: /identity progression charges add
commands.description: Adds charges to a stored identity entry.

commands.name: /identity progression jar list
commands.description: Lists soul jars and stored morphs for a player.

commands.name: /identity progression jar create
commands.description: Creates a soul jar entry for a player.

commands.name: /identity progression jar upgrade
commands.description: Upgrades an existing soul jar entry to a new tier.

commands.name: /identity progression jar store
commands.description: Stores a morph in a soul jar entry.

commands.name: /identity progression jar remove
commands.description: Removes a stored morph from a soul jar entry.

commands.name: /identity progression jar absorb
commands.description: Absorbs a stored morph through the soul absorption progression path.

commands.name: /identity_villager trade myself
commands.description: Trades with your own villager or wandering trader morph.

commands.name: /identity_villager trade
commands.description: Trades with another player's villager or wandering trader morph.
notes: The target must be in the same dimension.
The target must currently be morphed as villager or wandering trader.
